content_blocks.title: Inspectable example: Canonicalization, Hashing, and Digital Signatures
content_blocks.code:
canonical representation
        ↓
cryptographic hash
        ↓
sign or compare digest

Never sign an ambiguously serialized value; define canonicalization and verify the exact algorithm/standard first.
content_blocks.expected_output: A digital signature or hash requires a precisely defined byte representation; ordinary JSON member order/whitespace alone does not provide a universal canonical form.
